Card Q&A.q: If an effect that activates another effect for each XX can activate multiple types of effects multiple times, can I activate the same effect multiple times or activate different effects?

Card Q&A.a: An effect to activate is chosen, then the next effect to activate is chosen after the previous effect has been resolved.  This is repeated for each XX.
Card Q&A.q: If an effect that activates another effect for each XX can activate multiple types of effects multiple times, how is the effect activation order determined?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't.  The number of XX is referenced at the timing of activation for the effect that activates another effect for each XX.
Card Q&A.q: If the number of XX changes during activation of effects by an effect that activates another effect for each XX, does the number of activations also change?

Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't deleted yet.  Once all of the processing for the activated effect has resolved, a rule check will occur, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0.  At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of 0 deleted?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. When this card leaves the battle area, you can no longer reference the number of digivolution cards it has, so it can't be processed.
Card Q&A.q: When I activate this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area due to the "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon" part, an immediate-type effect such as "when [...] would leave" removes this card from the battle area.After that, can I process the "then, for every 5 of this Digimon's digivolution cards" part of this card's effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, for every 5 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate 1 of the effects below:
・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -13000 DP until their turn ends.
・Trash your opponent's top security card. Then, ＜Recovery +1＞.
